title: Old Maid
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Takahashi currently has $N$ cards. The $i$-th $(1\le i\le N)$ card has the integer $A _ i$ written on it.

He repeats the following operation as many times as possible.

- Choose two different cards with the same integer written on them, and eat those two cards. The eaten cards are permanently removed and cannot be chosen in subsequent operations.

Find the sum of the integers written on the cards that remain when the operation can no longer be performed.

## Constraints

- $1\le N\le100$
- $1\le A _ i\le100\ (1\le i\le N)$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A _ 1 A _ 2 \cdots A _ N
```

## Output

Output the sum of the integers written on the remaining cards.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Takahashi 目前有 $N$ 张卡片。第 $i$ 张 $(1\le i\le N)$ 卡片上写着整数 $A _ i$。

他不断重复以下操作，直到无法继续操作为止。

- 选择两张不同的、写有相同整数的卡片，并吃掉这两张卡片。被吃掉的卡片会被永久移除，无法在之后的操作中被选择。

求无法继续操作时，剩余卡片上所写整数的总和。

## 约束条件

- $1\le N\le100$
- $1\le A _ i\le100\ (1\le i\le N)$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入通过标准输入给出，格式如下：

```
N
A _ 1 A _ 2 \cdots A _ N
```

## 输出格式

输出剩余卡片上所写整数的总和。

samples.note:
For example, Takahashi operates as follows.

1. The fourth card and sixth card both have $8$ written on them, so he chooses them and eats them.
2. The first card and fifth card both have $2$ written on them, so he chooses them and eats them.
3. The third card and seventh card both have $1$ written on them, so he chooses them and eats them.

![image](https://img.atcoder.jp/abc473/839dc9d3f8c77f88619fee1b74e6428d.png)

Thus, the sum of the integers written on the remaining cards is $7+8=15$.

Note that there are three cards with $8$ written on them, so once two of them are eaten, the remaining one cannot be eaten.
It is possible that Takahashi cannot perform the operation even once.
